2. My MeshCore / Meshtastic weather script is working pretty well, going to add a few more …

Charlie 🐧💻🛠️ (@cdp1337@social.bitsnbytes.dev) · 🔁 2 · ❤️ 2 · 💬 0

Show post

My MeshCore / Meshtastic weather script is working pretty well, going to add a few more features like enabling/disabling various automation features like weather alerts, current conditions, and alerts, (currently they are all just enabled).

It can also do NL-based direct message support for queries like "how hot is it" which maps to the "temperature" command, MQTT uploads for acting as an observer, onboard sensors with fallback to openweathermap, and wifi upload of sensor data to HomeAssistant.

Any weather or mesh folks have ideas for other features to add?

OH, and unlike OpenHop, it's actually configured to run on an SD card without burning through write cycles and can connect to radios configured for standard companion mode.

So, my first #MeshCore-compatible device arrived today (an Elecrow ThinkNode M5, if anyone wondered). Kudos to the MC developers, who have made it a piece of cake to flash the firmware to your device via a Chromium-based browser and a USB cable. I even did mine on a Chromebook.

I set up the M5, paired it with various computers, turned it on, and... crickets. No users appeared. I knew I was likely my town's first MeshCore user, but I really hope the M5 isn't at fault here... 🧵 1/

Is there a #MeshCore or #Meshtastic community in #Boston / #CambridgeMA / #SomervilleMA that is *hardcore* "open", in a Fedi kind of way?

Every time I look into participating and hosting a relay, I see that an official app is closed, the firmware for an attractive device is closed and requires additional $ to unlock a feature, complaints someone unilaterally grabbed a trademark, an already small project forking again, a community using Discord, a map site leaking traffic to CloudFlare, etc.
